Subject: Weekly MAP touchpoint — Q4 renewal & elasticity add-ons

Hi Liam / Maya —

Following our renewal MAP checkpoint cadence, attaching the latest mutual action plan (Aperture_MAP_Q4_v2.xlsx) and a short agenda for today's sync. High level: Aperture is on track for the Nov 30 renewal target but procurement needs an audit artifact and the team continues to pilot elastic burst capacity. Goal for today is to align on procurement blocker, confirm add-on pricing for burst capacity, and lock owners / dates.

Agenda (15–20 min):
- Procurement / audit ask (Maya) — evidence needed + owner
- Usage trend and quota needs (Marissa) — past 30d consumption, expected delta
- Add-on / pricing proposal (Ben) — proposal and discount cadence for committed capacity + burst
- Timeline to sign (Tessa) — milestone checklist to Nov 30 close

Current open action snapshots (from MAP v2):
- Provide SOC2 attestation + evidence folder link — Owner: Aperture (Maya); ETA: 10/20
- Confirm pilot burst SLA & pricing — Owner: Redwood (Ben); ETA: 10/18
- Review usage by team and propose quota increments — Owner: Redwood CS (Marissa); ETA: 10/15

Please confirm if today's 10:30 PT still works — I'll send a short invite.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0192 | tessa.morgan@redwood.com

10:30 PT works for us. Quick heads-up ahead of the call: procurement will need a short evidence package for our security team — specifically an export of audit logs showing token-level access and retention settings, and the SOC2 Type II attestation PDF. We can deliver the SOC2 by 10/20 but the audit logs export depends on Redwood providing an extract or a guide for our security engineer.

Also want to flag a potential change: the Platform & Engineering team is likely to add two new internal teams to the evaluation in mid-Nov; that could bump committed capacity by ~20% if we proceed.

— Maya

- Last 30 days (09/13–10/13): 1.8M tokens (generation + embeddings), 12% week-over-week growth on the analytics team pilot.
- Active teams: Analytics (pilot), Platform (test), Product (light use). If Platform onboarded mid-Nov that would add ~350–400k tokens/mo at current patterns.

Action items I own and status:
- Review usage by team & recommend quota increments — In progress; preliminary suggestion: +25% quota for Analytics, +10% reserve for Platform (ETA internal draft: 10/15).
- Prepare an export showing API call patterns for security (will coordinate with infra) — Need Redwood infra assist for logs extraction (ping Ben).

Thanks — I'll present the usage slide in the 10:30.

Hi all —

Thanks for the sync earlier. Below is a short meeting note + consolidated action list pulled into the MAP. I uploaded the updated MAP (Aperture_MAP_Q4_v2.xlsx) and the SLA addendum draft (SLA_addendum_Aperture.pdf) to the shared drive (link below).

Meeting notes (10/20):
- Procurement: Aperture can deliver SOC2 attestation on 10/20 (received). Redwood to provide the scoped audit-log export or step-by-step extraction procedure — agreed owner: Ben Carter.
- Usage & capacity: Marissa confirmed 1.8M tokens in past 30d; Platform team onboarding projected to increase committed usage by ~20% starting mid-Nov.
- Pricing & add-ons: Ben presented burst capacity pricing: $0.007/token for on-demand burst above committed quota with a blended discount if they convert burst into committed capacity. Ben to send a redlineable quote by 10/22.
- Timeline: Parties agreed to target Nov 30 execute date with internal procurement signoff by 11/18.

Updated action items (owner — ETA):
- Deliver scoped audit-log export instructions (Ben Carter) — 10/22
- Finalize redlineable quote for burst add-on & committed tiers (Ben Carter) — 10/22
- Publish MAP with updated quotas & timeline (Tessa Morgan) — 10/21 (done)
- Provide short usage export for procurement review (Marissa Cole) — 10/22
- Legal: review SLA addendum; initial comments due (Aperture Legal) — 10/25

Attachments uploaded: Aperture_MAP_Q4_v2.xlsx; SLA_addendum_Aperture.pdf
